title: Fixed runtime evidence argument for synthetic autonomous-UAV telemetry
scope: Persistence-qualified monitor states updated through the current telemetry frame, plus fallback recommendations during deterministic replay. Claim support is not a physical-safety classification.

assumptions.statement: Replay fields faithfully represent upstream telemetry, preserve declared units, and have not been maliciously altered.
Telemetry timestamps and age fields share a sufficiently synchronized time basis for the configured freshness predicates.
Localization-confidence and cross-modal-consistency scores are calibrated for the declared operating context.
The stopping calculation uses a conservative deceleration lower bound and a response-time budget that are valid for the vehicle and context.
The current mission mode requires supervisory-link freshness at the configured bound.
fallback_available truthfully reports whether the recommended fallback path exists; command delivery and fallback effectiveness are not observed.

non_goals.statement: Complete or independently reviewed system-level STPA.
Physical-flight safety, airworthiness, certification, or threshold validation for a specific vehicle.
Command delivery, actuator response, closed-loop recovery, or a verified backup controller.
A Simplex/RTA safety architecture, verified safety filter, or certified fallback controller.
Conformance with SACM, GSN, or an aviation assurance standard.
Dynamic argument restructuring, evidence lifecycle management, change-impact analysis, or assurance governance.
Real-world false-intervention probability, fault prevalence, or detector validity.

claims.statement: Given the declared assumptions and telemetry processed through the current frame, all persistence-qualified monitor conditions required for continuation remain in their pass state.
The persistence-qualified localization and perception monitor states support the configured continuation policy.
Under the declared stopping-model assumptions, the persistence-qualified stopping-margin monitor state supports continuation.
Under the declared supervisory-mode assumption, the persistence-qualified communication-freshness monitor state supports continuation.
The persistence-qualified reported fallback-availability monitor state supports the existence of a configured fallback path.

evidence.artifact: persistence-qualified localization-confidence result updated through the current frame
persistence-qualified LiDAR-age result updated through the current frame
persistence-qualified camera-LiDAR consistency result updated through the current frame
persistence-qualified stopping-margin result derived under the versioned model assumptions
persistence-qualified communication-age result updated through the current frame
persistence-qualified reported fallback-availability result; execution is not observed
